subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about recovering repeat purchases for your marketplace in Tanzania. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed and collected order, read back through a server-to-server postback that holds through your confirmation window, so a cancelled or never-collected order does not bill. In a market where most shoppers pay cash on delivery, that is what separates a billed order from a paid one. At scale we hold 9,000 validated purchases a day across a retargeting pool. Worth a short look at the segment-level read?
angle: warm bump, restate validated-and-collected purchase proof
illustrative_flags: 9,000 validated purchases a day (MobUpps, illustrative daily retargeting purchase volume)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ecommerce retargeting Tanzania: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (S2S purchase postback + confirmation/collection window vs cash-on-delivery); one illustrative figure (9,000/day, flagged); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no 'X, not Y' (positive phrasing); native English, no transliteration.
